loading: Weighing up the latest court figures…
notCoveredTitle: We do not show court figures for {district} yet.
notCoveredBody: The National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG), a government portal, publishes the figures for every district. You can see them there now.
notReadTitle: We do not have court figures for {district} yet.
notReadBody: Our daily reading of the National Judicial Data Grid (NJDG) has not brought this district's figures so far. You can see them on NJDG now.
explainWaiting: Right now {pending} cases are waiting for a decision in the district courts of {district}.
explainAge: About {n} in 10 came in during the last year, and {over10} have waited more than 10 years.
explainYearDown: In {year} the courts decided {disposed} cases, more than the {filed} new ones that came in, so the pile got smaller.
explainYearUp: In {year} the courts decided {disposed} cases, fewer than the {filed} new ones that came in, so the pile grew.
explainYearEven: In {year} the courts decided about as many cases ({disposed}) as came in ({filed}).
ageTitle: How long have the cases been waiting?
ageLead: Every case waiting today, by the time since it was filed.
ageLong: Of these, {over20} have waited more than 20 years, and {over30} more than 30 years.
ageLongNone: None of them has waited more than 20 years.
civilHint: a dispute between people or firms — land, money, family.
criminalHint: a crime; the State takes the accused to court.
scaleTitle: Is the pile growing or shrinking?
scaleDown: In {year} the courts decided more cases than came in. The pile got smaller.
scaleUp: In {year} more cases came in than were decided. The pile grew.
scaleEven: In {year} the courts decided about as many cases as came in.
scalePerTen: For every 10 new cases, about {n} were decided.
scaleClear: At {year}'s pace, deciding every case waiting today would take about {years} years, even if no new case came in.
scaleAria: A balance: in {year}, {filed} cases came in and {disposed} were decided.
yearsTitle: New and decided cases each year
yearsUnits: All district courts together. Grey is new cases, colour is cases decided.
yearsSimple: In {year}, {disposed} cases were decided and {filed} new cases came in.
tookTitle: How long did decided cases take?
tookUnits: Cases decided in {year}, by the time from filing to decision.
tookSimple: Of the {total} cases decided in {year}, {fast} ({pct}%) were decided within a year.
tookAria: Cases decided in {year}, by time taken: {list}
unusualMonth: Last month's new cases ({count}) are far above the usual: about {usual} a month in {year}. NJDG does not say why.
unusualYear: {count} new cases have come in so far this year, far more than in all of {year} ({last}). NJDG does not say why.
courtsHint: Tap a court to see all its figures and open it on NJDG.
courtsOneHint: NJDG counts all of {district}'s district and taluk courts together.
cardWaiting: {n, plural, one {{count} case waiting} other {{count} cases waiting}}
highCourtHint: It hears appeals and some cases from the whole state, so it is not added to the district's figures.
missingNote: NJDG did not answer for {courts} on this check, so the totals leave it out.
sheetSubDistrict: District and taluk courts · figures from NJDG
sheetSubHigh: High Court · the whole state · figures from HC-NJDG
sheetSplit: Civil and criminal cases, by age
sheetHighCourtNote: A High Court hears cases from the whole state, not only this district.
checksLead: Before we show NJDG's figures, we check that its own counts agree.
checkAgeMatches: A second NJDG count of the waiting cases, by age, gives the same total: {found}.
checkAgeAddsUp: The civil and criminal age table adds up to the total: {found}.
checkAgeAddsUpClose: The civil and criminal age table adds up to within {gap} cases of the total.
checkDecided: NJDG's page of decided cases gives the same figure for {year}: {found}.
checkFailed: Did not agree: {expected} in one count, {found} in the other. We do not show the part that did not agree.
readOn: Read from NJDG on {date} at {time}. NJDG updates its figures once a day.
readOnHighCourt: High Court figures read on {date} at {time}.
fallbackNote: Only this year's totals are here right now. The full picture (how old the cases are, the trend) returns after the next daily check.
